```python
import pandas as pd

records = [
    {"Fund Name": "Fidelity Emerging Markets Index Fund", "Ticker": "FPADX", "NAV May 2019": 12.50, "NAV May 2024": 13.75, "Transaction Fee": "$0"},
    {"Fund Name": "Fidelity Emerging Asia Fund", "Ticker": "FSEAX", "NAV May 2019": 30.00, "NAV May 2024": 30.60, "Transaction Fee": "$0"},
    {"Fund Name": "Fidelity Emerging Markets Fund", "Ticker": "FEMKX", "NAV May 2019": 24.00, "NAV May 2024": 25.20, "Transaction Fee": "$0"},
]

df = pd.DataFrame(records)
df["Pct_Increase_%"] = (df["NAV May 2024"] - df["NAV May 2019"]) / df["NAV May 2019"] * 100

lowest = df.iloc[df["Pct_Increase_%"].argmin()]

print("Final Results Table:\n", df.to_string(index=False))
print("\nLowest percentage increase:")
print(f"{lowest['Fund Name']} ({lowest['Ticker']}) -> {lowest['Pct_Increase_%']:.2f}%")
```
